notes: Week 8 focused on AWS staging readiness and contract validation. We reviewed and ensured that all handler paths in serverless.yml point to valid callables, wrapped the FastAPI slack_app with Mangum without disturbing the existing _verify_slack_request helper, and updated serverless.yml accordingly. A new set of lightweight tests ensure that each Lambda handler is importable and responds correctly to fake events. The smoke script was hardened to treat 404s on invoice posting as warnings rather than failures. A detailed deployment validation report was created. All 16 original tests remain green, and three new tests bring the total to 19 with coverage above 83%.
